t_advice_summary_textbox.text: I found yellow and green gave the most, so generally went for them two colours.

vb_textbox.text: I chose brown, purple and blue. I found blue gave more than other. I generally avoided yellow and green, as I found these gave less, however sporadically if not selected for a while, they did give a large amount. Maybe, there isn't any logic to it and it's all random, and personal preference gives the impression of certan colours providing more, as in the event of chosing one colour, I woudn't ever know what the other provided.
